description: This file defines the EmployeeLicenseDecorator class, which provides methods to manipulate and format data related to EmployeeLicense entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functionality to set employee and license references, and to retrieve formatted license issue and expiry dates.

classes.name: EmployeeLicenseDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that provides additional methods for EmployeeLicense entities, including setting references to employees and licenses by their IDs, and formatted access to license dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeLicense object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee reference in the EmployeeLicense entity based on an employee number.

methods.name: setLicenseByLicenseId
methods.description: Sets the License reference in the EmployeeLicense entity based on a license ID.

methods.name: getLicenseIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted license issued date, or null if not set.

methods.name: getLicenseExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted license expiry date, or null if not set.
